patch.value: Overlap rechecked against main: pm-jira adfToPlainText flattens descriptions; existing export emits plain text as ADF; older attachment proposal is separate. pm-evidence owns generic citations, retention and freshness, not ADF structure. New scope: strict offline source snapshot plus explicit JSON-pointer selection; portable evidence packet with source revision and original coordinates, code/list/table boundaries, exclusion counts, approval bound to source digest, bounded agent output and typed refusals. No tracker mutations, journals, remote actions or attachment reads on this path; pm-evidence can cite the retained JSON output. Reuse the host command renderer, supported SDK loader, bounded file adapter and SDK testing harness. Existing native import/export/sync model regression will run in CI; new model checks capture against SDK-read native state without modifying it.
Capture selected structured Jira description blocks as portable evidence
Table cell and code block round-trip with stable source coordinates; unsupported nodes are counted; changed source revision refuses approved capture.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: portable read-only capture packets preserve original RFC 6901 coordinates and ancestor scaffolding, never pull attachments or mutate native items. Approval compares both the caller-provided source revision and complete description digest, catching same-revision edits as well. Replay validates the exact producer schema and digest. No transaction isolation or remote freshness claim: callers supply a newly read source snapshot; this feature has no target writes, leases or frozen journal. Existing atomic replay work remains tracked separately by pm-jira-atomic-replay-revisions.

Added documented example and pm-evidence citation handoff. Seeded 500-sequence selection/approval property passed; native import/export/sync reference-model coverage now also asserts capture/replay against exact SDK readback. Targeted malformed-schema, sparse-array, CRLF, foreign packet and non-git CLI checks are in progress.
